changelog:
* **fix: disable crashing lint check for Kotlin 2.1** (698079a)
  - disable NullSafeMutableLiveData lint check, whose detector crashes
    (IncompatibleClassChangeError) against Kotlin 2.1.0 analysis API
  - crash was failing :app:lintVitalAnalyzeRelease on release builds
  - check only warns on non-nullable MutableLiveData; low value, no
    real issues lost
  TEST: not run — Gradle unavailable on dev machine; build on Windows
        (gradlew.bat assembleRelease) or via CI
* **build: upgrade compose BOM and material3 for sheet+IME fix** (1a42248)
  - composeBom 2024.12.01 -> 2025.07.00 (ui/foundation 1.8.3), fixing IME
    insets delivery to edge-to-edge dialog windows
  - material3 1.3.2 -> 1.4.0 explicit version, adding sheet window-inset
    consumption (consumeWindowInsets) for the ModalBottomSheet
  - Fixes the grey scrim artifact and sheet bottom insets when the soft
    keyboard opens inside the quantity picker sheet
  TEST: not run — dependency bump; build on Windows (gradlew.bat assembleDebug)
